SearchProvider initializes Item_dev and Item_dev_sort_date via initIndex, selects byDate only when requested, calls index.search with perfParams, and checks results.query and results.hits. The bound SDK index search sends 1/indexes/%s/query.

The driver accepts only HTTPS on the exact public application hosts and the two source-backed index paths; it requires one selected row, full URL/input agreement, POST 200, one endpoint candidate, OpenAI response query, and a nonempty hits array of objects. Other index, multi-index, host, ambiguous, wrong-query and empty-result cases fail in the guard.

NetworkTab renders the selected response box immediately before ResultPreview; root object extraction produces one row, and ResultPreview table cells stringify the nested hits array. The previous rows-extracted text existed only as copy metadata.
The 37568984323 native failure predates this fix, stopped at initial_capture, and did not establish saved replay or cleanup. No installed-extension rerun followed this reviewed source.

The guard drives the exported selection and preview functions through a controlled panel transport; planted old route and invisible-preview predicates fail on a source-shaped response, and the corrected path passes.

Receipt diagnostics retain allowlisted endpoint shape, counts and booleans; candidate labels and full URLs remain transient. Checked click diagnostics and failure sanitization for raw URL, credential, body or query-value emission.
